summary: Master project controls for construction and infrastructure with CPM, earned value, cost control, and reporting. Learn practical tools and apply them fast.
lede: Project controls for construction and infrastructure provides a practical way to plan, measure, forecast, and correct performance across time, cost, scope, and risk. By connecting CPM schedules, earned value management, cost data, and field progress records, you can see where work stands, forecast the cost to finish, and identify activities driving the critical path. The course develops hands-on skills in baseline schedule review, earned value calculations, cost-loaded scheduling, trend analysis, change control mapping, and executive reporting. You will also practice dashboard design and reporting with tools such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Excel, and Procore, while learning operational approaches to delay analysis, contingency management, and recovery actions when site conditions change.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with construction schedules, budgets, or progress reporting and need stronger control over delivery performance. You may be supporting a contractor, consultant, owner, or infrastructure delivery team, and you need practical methods that fit day-to-day project reporting.
modules: CPM Schedule and Earned Value Metrics
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and a working knowledge of construction project documents, including schedules, cost reports, and progress updates. Prior exposure to Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Excel, or Procore is helpful but not mandatory because the exercises focus on operational use rather than software certification.
